name: Lune
source: Lune is mechanical doll about 70 centimeters tall and one of Madou Koukaku. Helps her master Eifelia, who rules over the Western Capital Burnie, they have relationship as if they were real sisters. Out of the four months that exist she represents and gets her name from the Blue Moon Goddess Ryushion governing over "Blue Moon".
